name: scwbs CLI
description: SC-WBS-managed development plan for this repository.

nodes.name: scwbs CLI project
acceptanceCriteria: The repository can validate its own contracts with scwbs check.
AI implementation work is bounded by Task Contracts.
Evidence is recorded before WBS nodes are completed.

nodes.name: Dogfood SC-WBS contracts
acceptanceCriteria: contracts/wbs/project.wbs.json exists and validates.
contracts/registry.yaml indexes active contracts.
At least one active Task Contract represents current work.

nodes.name: First-class Spec Contract support
acceptanceCriteria: Spec Contract files have a documented schema.
scwbs check validates Spec Contract metadata.
Task Contract locks can reference approved Spec versions.
Contract YAML files are parsed into objects and validated with JSON Schema.
Task Contract, Evidence, Approval, and Registry schemas are documented and enforced by scwbs check.
Existing semantic validators remain responsible for repository references and cross-file consistency.
The supported YAML subset and schema validation boundary are documented.
nodes.name: YAML contract JSON Schema validation
Test quality and coverage verification
acceptanceCriteria: Test diffs are inspected for disabled or weakened tests.
Coverage summaries are checked when available.
Evidence testQuality metadata is cross-checked with observed changes.

nodes.name: CI integration
acceptanceCriteria: scwbs check and health run in CI.
CI evidence can be referenced from Evidence files.

nodes.name: Task Contract draft generation
acceptanceCriteria: A CLI command can generate a draft Task Contract from a WBS node.
The generated contract keeps human review and locking as explicit steps.
Lean workflows can reduce manual contract authoring overhead.

nodes.name: WBS conflict mitigation
acceptanceCriteria: WBS merge and distributed WBS options are documented.
A low-cost semantic merge roadmap exists before large distributed WBS support.
Parallel agent workflows have a clear WBS conflict mitigation path.

nodes.name: Meta-file safety guardrails
acceptanceCriteria: Sensitive config and meta files are Human Gate required unless explicitly allowed.
check-diff prevents AI from evading path controls through project configuration changes.
Documentation treats meta-file changes as Level 2 by default.
scwbs check enforces that project.wbs.json changes require a corresponding changeset.
All existing Task Contracts list project.wbs.json as humanGateRequiredPaths.
Documentation explains the tool-only rule for project.wbs.json.
nodes.name: WBS JSON tool-only enforcement
Subtree-scoped bootstrap transition
acceptanceCriteria: Bootstrap and normal operation can coexist across WBS subtrees.
Transition criteria are defined per feature or milestone node.
AI Work Packet behavior can account for subtree phase.
Lightweight orchestration commands provide low-cost scaffolds for the roadmap.
Generated contract artifacts are not overwritten unless force is requested.
The implementation avoids new dependencies and keeps serve as a Human Gate follow-up.
nodes.name: SC-WBS lightweight orchestration roadmap

acceptanceCriteria: doctor summarizes check and health issues.
doctor prints actionable suggested fixes.
nodes.name: Doctor command

acceptanceCriteria: evidence collect creates Evidence from git state and required checks.
existing Evidence is not overwritten without force.
nodes.name: Evidence collect command

acceptanceCriteria: Working-tree changed files and base/head branch diffs are separate Git helper APIs.
check-diff uses a configurable base/head branch diff for PR readiness.
evidence collect records base, base commit, head commit, changed file basis, and branch-diff changed files.
health warns when Evidence provenance is missing or stale.
nodes.name: Evidence provenance and diff basis

acceptanceCriteria: task refresh previews lock drift.
task refresh apply updates only safe lock fields.
nodes.name: Task refresh command

acceptanceCriteria: registry rebuild regenerates registry from contract files.
profile show and set read and update WBS profile metadata.
nodes.name: Registry rebuild and profile commands

acceptanceCriteria: ai run prints guarded pre and post implementation steps.
ai run does not launch external agents in the initial implementation.
nodes.name: AI run dry-run orchestrator

acceptanceCriteria: review request creates a Review record.
existing Review records are not overwritten without force.
nodes.name: Review request command

acceptanceCriteria: next prints one suggested action.
next prioritizes stale tasks, missing evidence, review candidates, and planned work.
nodes.name: Next action command

acceptanceCriteria: ai packet supports compact, codex, claude, and cursor formats.
default packet output remains backward compatible.
nodes.name: AI packet format option

acceptanceCriteria: start creates draft artifacts from natural language.
plan creates draft task and WBS change-set candidates from a Spec.
nodes.name: Start and plan commands

acceptanceCriteria: lite task creates a small Task Contract.
promote creates formalization artifacts and reports stop conditions.
nodes.name: Lite task and promote commands

acceptanceCriteria: trace shows Spec, WBS, Task, Evidence, Review, and Approval links.
trace clearly marks missing links.
nodes.name: Trace command

acceptanceCriteria: ui prints a text dashboard without new dependencies.
serve fails clearly until a Human Gate approves dependency-heavy Web UI work.
nodes.name: UI dashboard and serve stub

acceptanceCriteria: check-diff fails when current branch differs from task branchName.
tests cover matching and mismatching task branches.
nodes.name: Task branch guard

acceptanceCriteria: review request records requested reviewers based on changed files.
review route previews reviewer assignments without writing files.
unresolved reviewer roles are surfaced for Human Gate follow-up.
nodes.name: Review routing command
Meta health audit and hygiene
acceptanceCriteria: The repository records the 2026-06-30 meta health audit under docs.
Tracked TypeScript JSON YAML and Markdown files use LF line endings by policy.
scwbs health warns about tracked CRLF text files and dirty submodule worktrees.
CI runs the core local scwbs validation commands.

nodes.name: Conflict cost guardrails
acceptanceCriteria: scwbs health warns when the current branch is behind origin/main.
scwbs health warns when both sides added the same SC-WBS contract path with different content.
Documentation records the PR #15 conflict lesson and the pre-PR mitigation workflow.
Recurring audit, specification, and governance work has a non-completed WBS target.
Spec change, risk, review independence, and profile enforcement artifacts are defined before strict enforcement is claimed.
Maintenance tasks can be discovered by scwbs ai next-task without reusing completed nodes.
nodes.name: Governance and specification maintenance
Fix Issue #130: synchronize package-lock.json with npm workspaces and use npm ci in CI

acceptanceCriteria: All unchecked items in docs/sc-wbs-core-revision/10-progress-checklist.md are represented by child WBS nodes or child node acceptance criteria.
Progress checklist completion remains backed by implementation, tests, documentation, Evidence, and check-diff.
nodes.name: SC-WBS Core revision backlog

acceptanceCriteria: M1-006: task new can generate stopIf from --stop.
M1-007: missing arguments can be completed interactively or by a safe non-interactive fallback.
M1-011: WBS-less operation updates contracts/tasks/index.yaml.
M1-012: WBS-backed operation does not edit WBS directly and generates a changeset draft when needed.
M1-013: scwbs start <task-id> displays pre-flight information.
M1-014: start displays branch, lock, path constraints, checks, and stopIf.
M1-020: next prioritizes blocked, missing evidence, failed check, and planned task states.
M1 test checks: taskId collision, start branch mismatch, and next priority ordering are covered.
M1 completion checks: new tasks can be created without hand-written YAML, Tiny Packet stays short, and existing Task Contracts remain usable.
nodes.name: Core Task Lifecycle completion

acceptanceCriteria: M2-003: Check Catalog is explicitly defined.
M2-009: Evidence records subjectHeadCommit.
M2-011: diffHash is generated from the subject diff.
M2-012: Evidence file commits do not make subject evidence stale.
M2-018: humanGateRequiredPaths changes without approval are errors.
M2-019: managedContractPaths are modeled as controlled exceptions.
M2-022: all errors include fixCommand.
M2-023: scwbs fix runs only safe automatic repairs.
M2 test checks: human gate approval error, managedContractPaths, subjectHeadCommit stale handling, and stable diffHash are covered.
M2 completion checks: Evidence commit design avoids self-reference loops and AI out-of-scope changes are mechanically blocked.
nodes.name: Finish Evidence and Diff Guard completion

acceptanceCriteria: M3-001: scwbs block "理由" is implemented.
M3-002: block reason is saved in a Block record.
M3-003: stop presets classify db, auth, permission, security, and breaking-api concerns.
M3-004: block output shows the needed human decision.
M3-005: block output tells the AI not to continue implementation.
M3-006: request-approval generates only requested records.
M3-007: approve is rejected in AI execution mode.
M3-008: approve is explicitly designed as a human operation.
M3-009: Approval records headCommit.
M3-010: Approval records diffHash.
M3-011: Approval records approvedBy and approvedAt.
M3-012: PR-number-only Approval is not treated as completion approval.
M3-013: changed diffs after approval are errors.
M3-014: Human Gate passes only when approval scope matches.
M3-015: completed status cannot be applied without approval.
M3-016: pre-implementation gate and completion gate are distinct.
M3 test checks: block, stop preset classification, AI-mode approve rejection, approval scope match/mismatch, and post-approval commit drift are covered.
M3 completion checks: AI stops dangerous work, Human approval is not auto-generated, and Approval is tied to commit/diff.
nodes.name: Human Gate and Approval Scope

acceptanceCriteria: M4-001: contracts/tasks/index.yaml is defined for WBS-less operation.
M4-002: tasks index manages status and dependsOn.
M4-003: task new, start, and finish work without a WBS.
M4-004: existing WBS behavior is preferred when WBS exists.
M4-005: WBS candidates can be generated from tasks index.
M4-006: WBS changes are generated as changesets instead of direct edits.
M4-007: base WBS plus changesets equals HEAD WBS can be verified.
M4-008: a changeset existing by itself does not pass validation.
M4-009: WBS root completion is rejected by default.
M4-010: migration from WBS-less to WBS-backed operation is documented.
M4 test checks: WBS-less E2E, WBS compatibility, changeset reproducibility, and direct WBS edit detection are covered.
M4 completion checks: Core works without WBS, remains compatible with Full SC-WBS projects, and WBS changes are reproducible from changesets.
v0.5: WBS-less operation, WBS-backed compatibility, tasks-index WBS candidates, and changeset reproducibility are complete.
nodes.name: WBS Optional and Full Integration

acceptanceCriteria: M5-001: minimal Review record data model is defined.
M5-002: review request can be generated from CLI.
M5-003: Review result is tied to commit/diff.
M5-004: completed status is blocked when review is incomplete.
M5-005: block can generate a Spec Change Proposal draft.
M5-006: Level 1 and Level 2 are distinguished in CLI behavior.
M5-007: registry validation is enabled only when registry exists.
M5-008: Lean, Core, Standard, and Strict differences are machine-checkable.
M5-009: Strict Risk Register is not mandatory for Core.
M5-010: Tiny Packet does not grow when Full features are enabled.
M5 test checks: Review record generation, review scope mismatch, Spec Change Proposal draft generation, profile validation, and Tiny Packet size with Full features are covered.
M5 completion checks: Core stays lightweight while Review, Spec Change, and Registry features activate only when needed.
nodes.name: Review Spec Change and Full Enhancement

acceptanceCriteria: v0.1 remaining: scwbs start is usable, work can start without YAML hand editing, and README includes the shortest usage path.
v0.2 remaining: managedContractPaths are supported, fixCommand appears where required, and CI-friendly JSON output exists.
v0.3 remaining: subjectHeadCommit, diffHash, and post-hoc PR number attachment are supported.
v0.4 remaining: block, request-approval, approve, approval headCommit/diffHash scope, post-approval diff detection, and AI approve rejection are supported.
nodes.name: Core release readiness checklist

acceptanceCriteria: AI allowed actions are backed by scoped implementation, tests, finish, block, and explicit context requests.

AI forbidden actions are enforced or documented: no guessed YAML/JSON edits, no allowedPaths violations, no forbiddenPaths edits, no Human approval generation, no uncontrolled completed status, no full WBS regeneration, and no unapproved spec changes.

Milestone review checks are enforced: checked items have tests, CLI help and docs are updated, compatibility is preserved, AI context stays short, fixCommand exists where needed, approval is not auto-generated, and dangerous operations fail safe.
nodes.name: AI operating rules and milestone review

acceptanceCriteria: MVP remaining: Evidence has subjectHeadCommit and diffHash.
MVP remaining: approve ties approval to diffHash.
MVP remaining: changed diffs after approval require re-approval.
MVP remaining: AI-facing documentation is short.
MVP remaining: existing SC-WBS Full specification coexists with Core.
